annotations.title: Jobs that fit a person's experience

description: Current US and Canadian openings ranked by how closely they fit a person's work history: the job titles they have held, years of experience, skills, place and minimum pay. For Canadian places, supported titles resolve to ESDC occupational profiles with official skill comparisons and entry requirements. US titles use O*NET and official wage groups. Ambiguous titles return occupation choices; openings are then ranked by title match, same or neighbouring occupation, skills named in the posting's title and seniority fit (intern and junior roles drop for experienced people, senior roles for people starting out). Each result says why it is listed, with available employer pay or the official median for context, and the link to apply on the employer's site. No job descriptions are read, so a skill counts only when the employer put it in the job title. Nothing about the person is stored. Same coverage limits as find_jobs.

include_remote.description: With a place: also include remote jobs (default true).

min_pay.description: Minimum of the employer’s posted yearly salary in USD. Hourly estimates and jobs without published salaries are excluded.

place.description: A US state (texas or TX), a large US metro area (austin), Canada, a Canadian province or a named Canadian municipality (Ottawa, ON). Leave out for everywhere.

same_occupation_only.description: true restricts openings to the identified occupations of the supplied job titles.

schedule.description: Restrict matches and career alternatives to an employer-stated schedule.

skills.description: Skills or specialties, twelve at most (ICU, pediatrics, Python).

titles.description: Job titles the person has held, most recent first, three at most (registered nurse, charge nurse).
